name: Swing Alley
design_intent:
SWING ALLEY — THE SCRAPWORKS tier-3 RHYTHM RUN (brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19 §Scrapworks row 15). Four islands over one full-width void, split by three 680px gaps, each guarded by a NON-lethal wrecking-ball PENDULUM on a staggered phase (0.0 / 0.33 / 0.66) — a rolling three-beat rhythm you must read to run the alley. A spring THRONE crowns the right. The balls are SHOVERS (<= 700px/s, no hitstun, never kill); the void is the killer. kill_shape = void_is_floor -> QA uses K1' (off-screen kills >= 88%; >= 15% of void deaths hazard-assisted).

HAZARD DOCTRINE (moving_hazard pendulum x3): each ball SHOVES a contacted body along the arm's motion direction, dwells ~0.8s up high at each apex (the clear beat), and dips into its gap centre over the void. STAGGERED phases (0.0/0.33/0.66) mean the three lanes peak their danger in sequence, so there is always at least one crossable gap — the alley is never fully locked. Balls are shovers, not stepping stones.

GEOMETRY: four flat trampoline islands over ONE full-width void: A x0..900 top1080 / B x1580..2480 top1080 / C x3160..4060 top1080 / D x4740..5640 top1080, all separated by 680px void gaps. THREE pendulums, arm_len 700, arc_deg 150, period_s 3.4, radius 100, dwell_frac 0.24: HAZ1 pivot (1240,300) over the A<->B gap phase 0.0 / HAZ2 pivot (2820,300) over B<->C phase 0.33 / HAZ3 pivot (4400,300) over C<->D phase 0.66. Each ball's low dip centre (pivot.x,1000) reaches y1100 dead in its gap over the void; apexes park up high at ~(pivot.x +/- 676, 481). ONE spring THRONE x5160..5540 top560 over island D (520px climb). Bounds -610..6250 x, top -2090, bottom 1878 (island outer edges >= 610px inside the side blast; 670px recovery sky). VOID READS AS DEATH via pit_void_rendering. Overcast grey open_sky = a wrecking alley.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning: trampoline apex 270 / spring 480; ~395px trampoline drift / ~527 max spring drift; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 680px in ~0.9-1.0s):
- GAPS A<->B, B<->C, C<->D (each 680px over void, each a ball's lane): > 527 and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. TIMING is load-bearing: cross each gap on its ball's apex dwell; the staggered phases mean the safe beat rolls down the alley. Verb: FLY (+ TIME).
- CLIMB to the spring THRONE (top560): 520px above island D (1080); trampoline apex 270 reaches only y810 (270px short). JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- RECOVER after a shove: the shove adds <= 700px/s with NO hitstun (full control), and island bottoms (1208) to the bottom blast line (1878) = 670px of open sky (>= 650) -> a fuelled shoved player boosts back (recovery gamble). Verb: FLY.
- No ball creates a bounce path across a gap (a shove only ADDS speed toward the void); every 680px gap exceeds a spring bounce's 527px reach and the throne sits > 480px above the island, so NO route across or up exists without the jetpack. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.

SIGNATURE: the three-beat wrecking run — the scaled-up sibling of single_swing/wrecking_yard, a rhythm gauntlet where the safe window rolls along the alley.
